About One Page Love - One Page Love

name: One Page Love
summary: Curated gallery of 9,000+ one page websites, plus 9,300+ page section examples, one page templates and a typeface archive.
description: Hand-picked one page website and landing page designs, each with a full-length screenshot, written review and tagged features; browse by genre, platform, tech or typeface. The same site collects page section examples from live websites, 307 one page templates with live demos and download links, the typefaces most used by the sites it curates, and design articles. A documented JSON API serves the same dataset.
contains: 9,164 one page websites and 9,303 page section examples, curated since 2008
307 one page templates with review, long screenshot, live demo and download links
filters: genre, platform, tech, typeface, dominant color, section type
typeface archive, e.g. Inter 375, Open Sans 222, Montserrat 181 one pagers
documented JSON API with a free tier over the same 9,000+ entries
genre categories from portfolio and landing page to restaurant and wedding
